matches.rationale: GT1 concerns conflicting assumptions about data distribution (heavy-tailed vs sub-Gaussian, unbounded vs bounded covariance spectrum) in the method section. Pred_1 identifies an equation error about training time relaxation rates in Section 3 after Theorem 3.2. These are completely different defects in different material.

GT2 concerns the oversimplified definition of generalization loss as L_gen = L_test - L_train in the method section. Pred_1 identifies an equation error about training time relaxation rates. These are unrelated defects.

pred_verdicts.rationale: This identifies a genuine mathematical error in an equation about training time relaxation rates that is not in the ground truth.
